subject.title: Feature: Inter-session progress streaming for sessions_send (ACP/long-running session support)

question: Should OpenClaw expose peer-run progress through a new `sessions_subscribe`/`agent.events` contract, a `sessions_send` progress option, or defer this to the broader structured process-events design?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the API crosses session, channel, tool-output, ACP, and retention boundaries that require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Add `agent.events` plus `sessions_subscribe`
options.body: Create a bounded, redacted, permission-checked read/long-poll API and a separate agent tool for observing delegated runs.

options.title: Extend `sessions_send` with progress mode
options.body: Keep one user-facing tool but make its result semantics more complex by optionally returning progress items or forwarding updates.

options.title: Defer to process events
options.body: Fold this into the broader structured process-events work so session progress has one source of truth across clients and tools.

recommendation.title: Add `agent.events` plus `sessions_subscribe`
recommendation.body: Create a bounded, redacted, permission-checked read/long-poll API and a separate agent tool for observing delegated runs.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans sessions_send, ACP session handling, gateway event routing, and docs areas where steipete has repeated recent history.
